Linguine Alfredo...
A house-made creamy garlic Alfredo sauce on a bed of linguini. Served with garlic bread and choice of chicken or shrimp

Wedge Salad ... 12
A crisp quarter-head of iceberg lettuce topped with creamy blue cheese ranch dressing, crispy bacon, diced tomatoes, and blue cheese crumbles.

Strawberry Shortcake ... 10
Flaky shortcake topped with sweetened strawberries and whipped cream. Just like Grandma used to make.

Appetizer:
Burrata Cheese & Roasted Heiroom Tomatoes ... 16
Roasted heirloom tomatoes, basil and creamy burrata
cheese drizzled with balsamic fig glaze, served with
toasted crostini.

Entrées:
Maryland Crab Cakes ... 45
Lump crab cake Maryland style, served with grilled
fingerling potatoes and roasted asparagus.

Pasta with Mussels & Garlic White Wine Sauce ... 28
Mussels in garlicky white wine sauce served over linguine
with crusty garlic bread.

Dessert:
Strawberry Tiramisu ... 10
Layers of ladyfingers, cream cheese, whipped cream
and fresh strawberries..

LUNCH SPECIAL: Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM

Crab Cake Sandwich ... 24
Pan-fried crab cake, on a toasted brioche bun,
lettuce, tomato, with tangy housemade remoulade
sauce. Served with fries.

“Coney Island “ Dog ... 13
An all-beef, Nathan’s dog, in a steamed bun
topped with chili, yellow mustard, and finely
chopped raw onions. Served with fries.

“New York Style”Dog ... 13
An all-beef, Nathan’s dog, in a steamed bun, topped with tangy sauerkraut and spicy brown mustard. Served with fries.
